blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Major foreign business groups have called on the government to set “clear, pre-disclosed rules” that respect existing laws and contracts, warning that the asset-surrender policy could dampen investor sentiment. In a position paper dated Nov. 24, the Joint Foreign Chambers of the Philippines (JFC) expressed its concerns about Administrative Order No. 2026-01 issued by the Department of Energy (DOE) and the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), particularly the part requiring incumbent operators to surrender their assets if they opt to join auctions for mining and resource deals.
